what_was_seen_before_writing: Only counts of screens per library and of new models (5 new Avana lines; about 199 models screened in any library that are not in this project's 24Q4 sets; their lineage counts for the 5 Avana lines). No gene effects, biomarker calls or test results for any hypothesis.
reason: DepMap 26Q3 has only 5 Avana-screened models outside the 24Q4 sets, so every pre-registered test is untestable under the original rule. New Broad screening since 24Q4 uses the Humagne-CD (Cas12) library.
original_rule_result: Reported as frozen: untestable (5 new lines).

amendment.new_lines: Models with a Humagne-CD (library CD) screen in 26Q3 that appear in NONE of this project's 24Q4 sets AND have no screen of any library in the 24Q4 ScreenGeneEffect file (first screened after 24Q4).
amendment.gene_effect: 26Q3 ScreenGeneEffect for library CD screens, averaged per model. Chronos scales each library (nonessential median 0, common-essential median -1), so the scale matches Avana.
amendment.sensitivity: Repeat including CD-screened models that were already in 24Q4's CD screens but unused by this project (unseen by us, but not screened after 24Q4). Reported separately, never pooled into the primary result.
amendment.everything_else: Unchanged: same hypotheses, biomarker definitions, lineage-adjusted one-sided test, p < 0.01, untestable if < 3 altered or unaltered lines, BH 5%, sign test, control power, drift check.

caveat_declared_in_advance: A different CRISPR system (Cas12, different guides) is a change of reagent as well as of cell lines. A replication here survives both; a failure could reflect either.
